anchors.description: The desktop starts a server with `kimi web --no-open`.
`kimi server run` is only a deprecation shim, not a real command.
Live servers publish host/port to <KIMI_CODE_HOME>/server/instances/*.json with these keys.
The bearer token is persisted at <KIMI_CODE_HOME>/server.token.
The server exposes GET /api/v1/healthz returning code 0.
The web UI bundle is committed and understands the desktop query/fragment markers.
Upstream still has no apps/kimi-desktop. If this fails, upstream re-added it and the restore patch may be obsolete.
Upstream release.yml is gated to the MoonshotAI org, which is why the fork needs fork-release.yml.
This fork relies on pnpm reading onlyBuiltDependencies from pnpm-workspace.yaml (pnpm 10+).
The TUI transcript/event plumbing the thinking-detail patch extends.

The web UI bundle probes window.kimiDesktop and offers a Browser panel, and it renders the agent's browser tool as mcp__desktop_browser__run (protocol kimi.browser/1.0.0). The desktop shell has to expose the preload bridges, back the panel with a maskable surface, and serve the desktop_browser MCP server itself, because the AppImage ships no Node interpreter to spawn a stdio entry.
